tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Start a MAGI-2 video generation (1080p, up to 30 s, optional native audio). Costs 20 Credits per second from the user's account. Rendering takes about 10-20 minutes: this returns immediately with a video id; call get_video every few minutes until status is "succeeded", then share video_url. Modes: t

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Get the status of a video from generate_video. When status is "succeeded", video_url is a direct MP4 link valid for 24 hours.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List the user's most recent MAGI-2 videos with their status.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Show the user's available Credits and how many seconds of video they cover.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Credits a video of the given duration costs (before generating).
